Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 
Mr. A.K. Sharma, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. V.S. Rawat Brief Holder for the 
State. 
 Misc. application IA No. 7164 of 
2020 is allowed. Counter affidavit filed 
on behalf of respondent no. 1 & 2 is 
taken on record. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
seeks and is granted four weeks’ time to 
file rejoinder affidavit. 
 List thereafter. 
Petitioner fails to make out any case 
of interim relief at this stage. The interim 
relief application no. 373 of 2020 is 
rejected.
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
